### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, touching **7** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**17** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c779611eb1db77a53e5e4c58b015cef93512792f`.

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **218** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **157** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **157**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **102** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c779611eb1db77a53e5e4c58b015cef93512792f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a46d56122a219de8317ea7781446b921902c9832` — the merge of head `07327a14678c408dfea64df24bba145819ecd134` into base `c779611eb1db77a53e5e4c58b015cef93512792f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a46d56122a219de8317ea7781446b921902c9832 && git checkout a46d56122a219de8317ea7781446b921902c9832
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c779611eb1db77a53e5e4c58b015cef93512792f 07327a14678c408dfea64df24bba145819ecd134 && git checkout -B drift-repro c779611eb1db77a53e5e4c58b015cef93512792f && git merge --no-ff 07327a14678c408dfea64df24bba145819ecd134

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c779611eb1db77a53e5e4c58b015cef93512792f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c779611eb1db77a53e5e4c58b015cef93512792f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `07327a14678c408dfea64df24bba145819ecd134`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration only (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and the changeset). No published schema (`packages/spec/**` untouched) and no governed path in the committed tree (6 files: `.changeset/29544-superuser-field-mask-inert.md`, `packages/cli/test/superuser-bypass-mirror-parity.test.ts`, `packages/lint/src/{index,rule-explanations,validate-security-posture,validate-security-posture.test}.ts`), so no ④.

### ① Derived judgments

- Public surface added on the published `@objectstack/lint` entry (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`): `SECURITY_SUPERUSER_FIELD_MASK_INERT` (a rule-id constant, the same shape as the 19 sibling `SECURITY_*` exports) and `holdsSuperuserBypass(set, objectName, bit)`. Correct to declare as widening: both are new names reachable from the package entry. Same declaration as precedent PR #29424 (new `@objectstack/lint` exports, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, patch).
- `holdsSuperuserBypass` in lint is byte-for-byte the body of core's (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`, read on `origin/main`): own entry else `'*'`, lookup not merge, `Boolean(...)` bits, Modify All implies View All. The parity pin (`packages/cli/test/superuser-bypass-mirror-parity.test.ts`, 410 cases, both answers exercised) imports each package's export by name, so a drift on either side reds it; the PR records one ablation (wildcard-first lookup: 60 diverging cases, red; restored green).
- Accept set: unchanged. The new rule is a `warning` pushed from the existing `validateSecurityPosture` entry; no input that was accepted is refused (the PR measures the runtime publish gate returning it under `advisories` with `errors` empty).

### ② Semver level

`Metadata-protocol: none` (nothing an author writes changes) ⇒ `patch` on `@objectstack/lint`, as the changeset says; a non-protocol widening ships `patch` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). `@objectstack/cli` gains a test file only and publishes nothing new, so no `cli` entry is owed. The PR body line was corrected from `no` to `yes (widening)` by a seat-signed body patch; the changeset carries the same line at this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none in report 6594219243.
- Out-of-scope note (admin-ledger dogfood's `withheld` / `wildcard` readers are not actually withheld under ruling A): dropped — a test-file header comment, unpublished, no assertion depends on the mask.
- PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay write).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-dhnwh9`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbYyp6wSRcywGFK2L4A`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@objectstack/lint` 新增 warning 规则 `security-superuser-field-mask-inert`：权限集对某对象持有「查看全部」或「修改全部」，同一集合又对该对象字段写了 `readable: false`（或「修改全部」下的编辑锁）时，提示该遮罩对持有人不生效并给出改法。
- 为什么改：#29106 裁决 A 后，超级用户位对该对象每个字段都投票，同集合的遮罩成了摆设；作者以为字段藏住了，其实没有，仓里已有两个测试夹具因此被修过。
- 风险与回滚：只是 warning，任何入口都不拒收（运行时发布门禁实测记为 advisory）；示例、showcase、平台默认权限集普查均 0 条。回滚即 revert，无迁移。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` 新规则段与 `holdsSuperuserBypass` 副本；`packages/cli/test/superuser-bypass-mirror-parity.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-security-posture.test.ts -t inert`，8 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：lint 不能依赖 core，所以走副本 + 410 例对拍测试（路线 C，席位裁定）；对拍测试的消融实测 60 例分歧即红，副本漂移会被抓到。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · `domain:server#3` · head `07327a14678c408dfea64df24bba145819ecd134` · 2026-11-03T03:18Z · seat review of record at `TIER_DEFAULT` (not governed: `check-governed-merges --pr 29724` NOT governed, 403 lines; no `packages/spec` path; owed face = the `Clause-②: yes` declaration alone, recorded PASS in 6594281079)

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, `Fixes #29544`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; PR body line and changeset agree (`@objectstack/lint` patch, precedent #29424 for new exports from a published non-protocol package). 6 files, +402/-1. New public names: rule id `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` and the `holdsSuperuserBypass` export (same name as core's on purpose; PM-discretion veto window).
2. **Premise measured:** red first on 61adbe57 (`-t inert` 7 failed / 1 control passed); the two fixtures #29387 repaired are spelled as cases 1–2 in their pre-repair form and fire. Parity pin ablation (lint lookup made wildcard-first): 60 diverging cases, 2 of 3 red; restored to HEAD blob.
3. **Gates on this head:** check-runs pinned to `07327a14`: 63 total, 54 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed (Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check success); `mergeable_state` clean. Dev pass on c20d3a56: 58/58 derived gates exit 0, `--ran` 0 unrun, `pnpm lint` 0, lint 7942/7942; the move to 07327a14 is the changeset/PR declaration line and a doc-comment move above `identifierHasRoleToken` (seat-requested), so CI is the evidence for it.
4. **Prose checked against the diff:** the changeset read sentence by sentence against the arm and the copy: "View All beside an edit lock is not reported, because View All never widens a write" (no View All + lock branch; case 4), "`editable` omitted" counts as a lock (parsed `false`; case 6), "The warning never refuses anything … reported as an advisory" (severity `warning`; dev measured `advisories`, `errors` empty), and "the set's own entry for the object, else its `'*'` entry, as a lookup and never a merge" (`objects[name] || objects['*']`; case 5 and the parity pin). Each holds.
5. **Out of scope:** the admin-ledger dogfood note (its withheld readers are not withheld by the mask under ruling A) → dropped: test-file comment, unpublished, no assertion rests on the mask. `Skills-docs:` not owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
6. **Landing:** not governed, under 3000 lines ⇒ the seat lands it (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`). At MERGED: landing record on #29544 (closed by `Fixes`), `pm:dispatched` removed, card thread released.
